items.source: Decorates the supplied Node by delegating to the BeanDefinitionDecorator that is registered to handle that Node.
items.translation: 通过委托给已注册用于处理该 Node 的 BeanDefinitionDecorator，来装饰所提供的 Node。

items.source: Parses the supplied Element by delegating to the BeanDefinitionParser that is registered for that Element.
items.translation: 解析提供的Element，方法是委托给为该Element注册的BeanDefinitionParser。

items.source: Provides the registerBeanDefinitionParser(String, BeanDefinitionParser) and registerBeanDefinitionDecorator(String, BeanDefinitionDecorator) methods for registering a BeanDefinitionParser or BeanDefinitionDecorator to handle a specific element.
items.translation: 提供 `registerBeanDefinitionParser(String, BeanDefinitionParser)` 和 `registerBeanDefinitionDecorator(String, BeanDefinitionDecorator)` 方法，用于注册一个 `BeanDefinitionParser` 或 `BeanDefinitionDecorator` 来处理特定元素。

items.source: Subclasses can call this to register the supplied BeanDefinitionDecorator to handle the specified element.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来注册提供的BeanDefinitionDecorator以处理指定的元素。

items.source: Subclasses can call this to register the supplied BeanDefinitionDecorator to handle the specified attribute.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来注册提供的BeanDefinitionDecorator以处理指定的属性。

items.source: Subclasses can call this to register the supplied BeanDefinitionParser to handle the specified element.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来注册提供的BeanDefinitionParser以处理指定的元素。

items.source: Subclasses can call this to register the supplied BeanDefinitionParser to handle the specified element. The element name is the local (non-namespace qualified) name.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来注册提供的 BeanDefinitionParser 以处理指定的元素。元素名称是本地（未命名空间限定）名称。

items.source: Subclasses can call this to register the supplied BeanDefinitionDecorator to handle the specified element. The element name is the local (non-namespace qualified) name.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来注册提供的 BeanDefinitionDecorator 以处理指定的元素。元素名称是本地（非命名空间限定）名称。

items.source: Subclasses can call this to register the supplied BeanDefinitionDecorator to handle the specified attribute. The attribute name is the local (non-namespace qualified) name.
items.translation: 子类可以调用此方法来注册提供的 BeanDefinitionDecorator 以处理指定的属性。属性名称为本地（非命名空间限定）名称。
`parse` 接口 `NamespaceHandler` 中
`decorate` 接口 `NamespaceHandler` 中

items.source: parserContext - the object encapsulating the current state of the parsing process
items.translation: parserContext - 封装当前解析过程状态的对象

items.source: node - the source element or attribute that is to be parsed
items.translation: node - 要解析的源元素或属性

items.source: element - the element that is to be parsed into one or more BeanDefinitions
items.translation: element - 要解析为一个或多个 BeanDefinitions 的元素

items.source: the primary BeanDefinition (can be null as explained above)

the decorated definition (to be registered in the BeanFactory), or simply the original bean definition if no decoration is required. A null value is strictly speaking invalid, but will be leniently treated like the case where the original bean definition gets returned.
items.translation: 装饰后的定义（注册到 BeanFactory 中），或者如果不需要装饰，则直接返回原始的 Bean 定义。严格来说，`null` 值是无效的，但会被宽容地处理为返回原始 Bean 定义的情况。
